run_detail.final_report_title: 研究报告：HTTP/3 与 HTTP/2 在拥塞控制和丢包恢复上的实现差异是什么？引用 RFC。
run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# HTTP/3 与 HTTP/2 在拥塞控制与丢包恢复上的实现差异

本次核验的资料显示，HTTP/3 借助 QUIC 的独立流机制，单个资源丢包不会阻塞其他流，而 HTTP/2 运行在 TCP 之上，传输层丢包仍会造成跨流的队头阻塞；QUIC 还自行定义了确认与 PTO 计时器、拥塞控制伪代码，而 HTTP/2 的拥塞控制由 TCP 传输层承担，协议本身不定义算法。至于 HTTP/2 在确认与包号设计、传输层细节及自身丢包检测与恢复机制上的实现，目前可核验的证据不足以作答。

## 直接回答

拥塞控制方面，HTTP/3 在 QUIC 之上运行，本次核验的资料显示 QUIC 的拥塞控制以 NewReno 为示例实现，其伪代码位于附录 B（Congestion Control Pseudocode）；而 HTTP/2 是运行在 TCP 连接上的面向连接应用层协议，拥塞控制由 TCP 传输层承担，协议本身不定义拥塞控制算法。 [evidence:c288ed716334c87abb4eb03fd4834824a35b336401c43d69] [evidence:624942c824741924addc43929554580c738af49c3c7056d4]

丢包恢复方面，HTTP/3 的关键优势是消除队头阻塞：QUIC 在 UDP 之上提供独立流，某个资源丢包不会拖住其他资源，只有拥有该数据的流需要等待；HTTP/2 由于运行在 TCP 之上，传输层丢包仍会造成跨流的队头阻塞，拥塞、丢包引发的 TCP 重传或 TCP 慢启动也会延迟传输。 [evidence:1106143c2f0cf07fb42ff395c08e96c1508dacda36948ef0] [evidence:069577376ebf496e9a3fffa9aaab23cc2c6177a5e66c899a] [evidence:55b8baa00c693bd6685612091b618bb8ba39114fd0f6e94f] [evidence:f16694a5633e27dfa54a949d4bf23e9f7cbfb9db888aa246]

在丢包检测的计时器设计上，QUIC 在每次发送或确认 ack-eliciting 包时重启 PTO 定时器，使 PTO 始终基于最新 RTT 估计和正确的包数空间设置；当 PTO 定时器超时，PTO backoff 必须增加，PTO 周期变为当前值的两倍。 [evidence:43bc28818c8fa30276aa216028ebc230230299f03e605625] [evidence:63a0ed961bbe640bc00c5487ebf78d66bb63283680b916f0] [evidence:358a3e5460e1707abf05e3509bf4f59666a35c37dad55e83]

## 传输层分工与拥塞控制的归属

两者的差异首先来自传输层分工。在 QUIC 版本 1 中，承载 HTTP 帧的流数据由 QUIC STREAM 帧传输，但这种分帧对 HTTP 分帧层不可见；当 HTTP 字段和数据通过 QUIC 发送时，QUIC 层处理大部分流管理，HTTP 无需再单独做多路复用。因此拥塞控制与流调度落在 QUIC 一侧，QUIC 以 NewReno 为示例给出拥塞控制伪代码，置于附录 B。 [evidence:0fd6e5f96c520d4e56fce96c9c68fd5db757a2173fd80415] [evidence:2fdf6988450609602090650b95202bc265f38954ed13a86e] [evidence:c288ed716334c87abb4eb03fd4834824a35b336401c43d69]

HTTP/2 则把这一层交给 TCP：它是运行在 TCP 连接上的面向连接应用层协议，因此拥塞控制由 TCP 传输层实现，HTTP/2 自身不定义拥塞控制算法。这意味着评价两者拥塞控制行为的落点不同——前者在 QUIC 的恢复与拥塞控制规范中，后者在 TCP 的实现中。 [evidence:624942c824741924addc43929554580c738af49c3c7056d4]

## 丢包恢复：队头阻塞与 PTO 计时器

本次核验的资料显示，HTTP/3 宣传的核心特性仍是不存在队头阻塞：QUIC 在 UDP 之上提供独立流，某个资源丢包不会停滞其他资源；具体而言，流之间相互独立，只有拥有丢失数据的流需要等待。这正是它在丢包场景下与 HTTP/2 的关键分野。 [evidence:1106143c2f0cf07fb42ff395c08e96c1508dacda36948ef0] [evidence:069577376ebf496e9a3fffa9aaab23cc2c6177a5e66c899a]

HTTP/2 的队头阻塞来自 TCP：由于 HTTP/2 运行在 TCP 之上，传输层丢包仍会造成跨流的队头阻塞；此外，网络拥塞、丢包及其引发的 TCP 重传、TCP 慢启动等网络状况都可能延迟传输，使较晚的响应被较早的响应阻塞。 [evidence:55b8baa00c693bd6685612091b618bb8ba39114fd0f6e94f] [evidence:f16694a5633e27dfa54a949d4bf23e9f7cbfb9db888aa246]

在检测与恢复的计时器上，QUIC 的 PTO 设计有两个可核验的要点：发送方应在每次发送或确认 ack-eliciting 包时重启 PTO 定时器，从而使 PTO 始终基于最新 RTT 估计和正确的包数空间设置；一旦 PTO 定时器超时，PTO backoff 必须增加，PTO 周期被设为当前值的两倍。 [evidence:43bc28818c8fa30276aa216028ebc230230299f03e605625] [evidence:63a0ed961bbe640bc00c5487ebf78d66bb63283680b916f0] [evidence:358a3e5460e1707abf05e3509bf4f59666a35c37dad55e83]

| 对比维度 | HTTP/3（RFC 9114） | HTTP/2（RFC 9113） |

| 拥塞控制的归属与算法 | 由 QUIC 承担；以 NewReno 为示例实现，伪代码见附录 B（Congestion Control Pseudocode） | 由 TCP 传输层承担；协议本身不定义拥塞控制算法 [evidence:c288ed716334c87abb4eb03fd4834824a35b336401c43d69] [evidence:624942c824741924addc43929554580c738af49c3c7056d4] |
| 传输层承载 | QUIC 版本 1 中，承载 HTTP 帧的流数据由 QUIC STREAM 帧传输，该分帧对 HTTP 分帧层不可见；QUIC 层处理大部分流管理 | 面向连接的应用层协议，运行在 TCP 连接上 [evidence:0fd6e5f96c520d4e56fce96c9c68fd5db757a2173fd80415] [evidence:2fdf6988450609602090650b95202bc265f38954ed13a86e] [evidence:624942c824741924addc43929554580c738af49c3c7056d4] |
| 丢包检测计时器（PTO） | 每次发送或确认 ack-eliciting 包时重启 PTO 定时器；超时后 PTO backoff 必须增加，周期变为当前值的两倍 | 本次核验的资料未覆盖其自身的丢包检测与恢复机制 [evidence:43bc28818c8fa30276aa216028ebc230230299f03e605625] [evidence:63a0ed961bbe640bc00c5487ebf78d66bb63283680b916f0] [evidence:358a3e5460e1707abf05e3509bf4f59666a35c37dad55e83] |

## 引用核对

### **No head-of-line blocking.** Still the headline feature. Independent streams over UDP mean a lost packet for one resource doesn’t stall the others

- 研究项：`HTTP/3 (RFC 9114) · Head-of-line blocking behaviour on loss`
- 候选：`c86f2871-ef26-454c-84f9-416d5ece8355`
- Evidence: `evidence:1106143c2f0cf07fb42ff395c08e96c1508dacda36948ef0`
  - Exact quote: “**No head-of-line blocking.** Still the headline feature. Independent streams over UDP mean a lost packet for one resource doesn’t stall the others”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/2e9536fb-d247-4000-a692-f8e1b47293d2/7a5d75aeb8710b2e462d7347f1d0b08fe53866d84e1cdfaed695586fe614cce2`
  - URL: https://ma.ttias.be/quic-http3-in-2026/

### QUIC 在每次发送或确认 ack-eliciting 包时重启 PTO 定时器，使 PTO 始终基于最新 RTT 估计和正确包数空间设置

- 研究项：`HTTP/3 (RFC 9114) · Acknowledgement and packet-number design`
- 候选：`273256a7-81e4-4508-98ab-877ec70ecbe7`
- Evidence: `evidence:43bc28818c8fa30276aa216028ebc230230299f03e605625`
  - Exact quote: “A sender SHOULD restart its PTO timer every time an ack-eliciting packet is sent or acknowledged”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/f0f05b50-958b-46cf-b720-e5ccd28593a0/0f4bfecbb29a5c9d2be95aed9a43767f5be8fb8127f4f44cb57a60097ea96535`
  - URL: https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9002/

### QUIC 的拥塞控制以 NewReno 为示例实现，其伪代码位于 Congestion Control Pseudocode 附录

- 研究项：`HTTP/3 (RFC 9114) · Congestion control location and algorithm`
- 候选：`af59efe2-ace8-4cac-9d99-b7c519b1ab27`
- Evidence: `evidence:c288ed716334c87abb4eb03fd4834824a35b336401c43d69`
  - Exact quote: “## Appendix B. Congestion Control Pseudocode”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/2e5cec93-08d4-4559-ab20-5b4d2fbfac79/b426f0a743f6eea5bf7f4f27a7b8ae06c63e632548647af523d5a7da2b09a5a3`
  - URL: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-quic-recovery-19

### In version 1 of QUIC, the stream data containing HTTP frames is carried by QUIC STREAM frames, but this framing is invisible to the HTTP framing layer.

- 研究项：`HTTP/3 (RFC 9114) · Transport layer`
- 候选：`e762ab8c-2b8a-46c4-9fdb-7a27fceabd37`
- Evidence: `evidence:0fd6e5f96c520d4e56fce96c9c68fd5db757a2173fd80415`
  - Exact quote: “In version 1 of QUIC, the stream data containing HTTP frames is carried by QUIC STREAM frames, but this framing is invisible to the HTTP framing layer.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/4ed5bd82-bb59-4a5e-be73-6601f8aed22d/0621b83d8beab50d3986b11b61d56e8e62155fc87b66cd666074e0a43e51606a`
  - URL: https://quicwg.org/base-drafts/rfc9114.html

### PTO 定时器超时后，PTO backoff MUST be increased，PTO 周期变为当前值的两倍

- 研究项：`HTTP/3 (RFC 9114) · Loss detection and recovery mechanism`
- 候选：`b9e41863-4d80-450f-ad6b-08165437b7cb`
- Evidence: `evidence:63a0ed961bbe640bc00c5487ebf78d66bb63283680b916f0`
  - Exact quote: “When a PTO timer expires, the PTO backoff MUST be increased, resulting in the PTO period being set to twice its current value.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/4ed5bd82-bb59-4a5e-be73-6601f8aed22d/0f4bfecbb29a5c9d2be95aed9a43767f5be8fb8127f4f44cb57a60097ea96535`
  - URL: https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9002/

### HTTP/2 运行在 TCP 之上，因此传输层的丢包仍会造成跨流的队头阻塞。

- 研究项：`HTTP/2 (RFC 9113) · Head-of-line blocking behaviour on loss`
- 候选：`115bc94f-7dcc-467f-8408-c8077419309d`
- Evidence: `evidence:55b8baa00c693bd6685612091b618bb8ba39114fd0f6e94f`
  - Exact quote: “Packet loss at the transport layer can still cause HOL blocking across streams because HTTP/2 runs”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/caafe252-37b9-4a4f-802c-fa07e59b54d6/a93c0a00ccfa8b03f354f1bb2ba932d7856953f4f979125a1c749ca52a0874cf`
  - URL: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Head_of_line_blocking

### HTTP/2 运行在 TCP 连接上，拥塞控制由 TCP 传输层承担，协议本身不定义拥塞控制算法。

- 研究项：`HTTP/2 (RFC 9113) · Congestion control location and algorithm`
- 候选：`04894de7-a822-46d4-82fa-e4df801cfc76`
- Evidence: `evidence:624942c824741924addc43929554580c738af49c3c7056d4`
  - Exact quote: “HTTP/2 is a connection-oriented application-layer protocol that runs over a TCP connection ([[TCP]](#RFC0793)).”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/3319fc5a-8a23-4fa0-8e57-ccbcc89b4c87/f804f706682bc9c49da55aa572e4079624578818ca19f3a3844bb1e5e7998ce6`
  - URL: https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9113.html

- **HTTP/2 (RFC 9113) · Acknowledgement and packet-number design**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）
- **HTTP/2 (RFC 9113) · Transport layer**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）
- **HTTP/2 (RFC 9113) · Loss detection and recovery mechanism**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）

columns.label: Head-of-line blocking behaviour on loss
columns.description: How a single lost packet affects other streams/requests, i.e. TCP HOL blocking in HTTP/2 vs stream-independent recovery in QUIC.

columns.label: Acknowledgement and packet-number design
columns.description: How ACK frames / packet numbers differ from TCP (e.g. QUIC monotonic packet numbers, ACK ranges) and how this enables more precise loss detection.

columns.label: Congestion control location and algorithm
columns.description: Where congestion control is implemented (TCP stack vs QUIC) and which congestion-control algorithms/specs apply, with RFC section quotes.

columns.label: Transport layer
columns.description: Which transport protocol carries each HTTP version and which RFC specifies it, since congestion control and loss recovery live in that transport.

columns.label: Loss detection and recovery mechanism
columns.description: How lost packets are detected and recovered (RTO, fast retransmit, packet/ACK-number thresholds), citing the defining RFC sections.
